title: [TASK 4-2] Add get_branch_context and get_review_comments tools to MCP server
body:
Completes the MCP server's three-tool surface by adding `get_branch_context` and `get_review_comments` alongside the existing `get_ci_failure_context`.

### Changes

**`src/mcp_server.py`**
- Added `get_branch_context(branch)` tool — fetches HEAD SHA, commits-ahead-of-base, CI status, open PR number, and merge conflict flag via GitHub API; returns `BranchContextPayload(ci_status="none")` on any exception (e.g. branch not found)
- Added `get_review_comments(pr_number)` tool — queries SQLite for all PR comments, filters to `is_blocking=True`, surfaces `author_type` (`human_review | ai_review | ci_automated | agent_self`) so the agent can ignore bot noise; returns empty list for unknown PRs
- Updated `call_tool()` dispatcher to route both new names
- Top-level imports for `asdict`, `db_get_review_comments`, `BranchContextPayload`, `ReviewComment`, `ReviewCommentsPayload`; GitHub client import remains lazy inside `_get_branch_context` to avoid credential access at module load

**`tests/test_mcp_server.py`**
- 6 new tests covering: all 3 tools present in `list_tools()`, graceful fallback on missing branch, empty result for unknown PR, `author_type` round-trip through SQLite, and dispatcher routing for both tools

```python
# Nonexistent branch → structured payload, no exception
result = await _get_branch_context("nonexistent-branch")
# → {"event_type": "branch_context", "branch": "nonexistent-branch", "ci_status": "none", ...}

# PR with no comments → empty blocking list, no exception
result = await _get_review_comments(999)
# → {"event_type": "review_comments", "pr_number": 999, "blocking_comments": [], "total_comments": 0}
```
